prompt_sampler_mask_contract.prompt_components: SYSTEM_TEMPLATE + first original user message + CHOICE_QUESTION as mid-system message; original compatibility fallback and adapter tokenizer/template must be preserved
prompt_sampler_mask_contract.first_prefill_active_mask: mark_ranges called before first forward from mark_len=0: all attended prompt positions, including added generation prompt, have mask1; left padding mask0
prompt_sampler_mask_contract.decode_mask: current coefficient applied to each forwarded row; original terminal-row compute/RNG behavior must remain unchanged for a faithful comparison
prompt_sampler_mask_contract.delta_arithmetic: BF16 mask * BF16 coefficient * BF16 saved direction; BF16 residual addition; not current project FP32 delta arithmetic
prompt_sampler_mask_contract.sampler: GPU per-row torch.Generator; inverse-CDF on descending sorted softmax(logits/.7), top-p .95; one uniform per sampled row per loop, including rows already inactive until the batch terminates
prompt_sampler_mask_contract.schedule: original stable sort by total message character length; original loop tie order; RNG states restored on CUDA OOM and contiguous rows halved
prompt_sampler_mask_contract.cache: fresh DynamicCache per segment; explicit attention/position IDs; left-pad to cohort maximum with no128 alignment

one_gpu_feasibility.one_H100: Source explicitly supports32B on one H100 with recognized OOM row splitting. Source asserts hardware name, not measured memory sufficiency here. Exact original environment still required.
one_gpu_feasibility.one_H200: Base weights alone are about61.03GiB; residency appears plausible on the project H200, but full memory/throughput is unmeasured. Requires explicit documented hardware guard adaptation; cannot call this unchanged original runtime.
one_gpu_feasibility.paired_comparison: Both paths can preserve identical source message text, token IDs, cohort membership/order, per-row seeds, sampler algorithm, full first-prefill mask and delta arithmetic prospectively. Current project backend does not already implement that contract.
one_gpu_feasibility.subset_limitation: Official entrypoint asserts46384 trials and continues later turns. A1212-row first-choice slice needs an explicit restricted-grid/termination adaptation. Reduced companions and possible OOM splits prevent claiming bitwise reproduction of historical samples.
